items.title_zh: 千寻智能联合创始人高阳：人形机器人最快明年就能“听懂人话”，真正“帮人做事”仍需时日
items.title_en: Qianxun Intelligence's Gao Yang: Humanoids May Understand Speech Next Year, but Truly Doing Useful Work Takes Longer
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 18 日消息，据路透社今天（18 日）晚间报道，清华大学机器人学助理教授、千寻智能联合创始人兼首席科学家高阳预计，最快从明年开始，人形机器人就能 听懂口头指令并完成大多数通用任务 ，但真正进入家庭、承担实用工作仍需时日。 中国人形机器人的硬件能力近年快速提升，冲刺、跳舞甚至按指令完成后空翻都已不成问题。机器人企业的竞争重心也随之转向软件，目标是提高机器人的智能水平，让机器人能够承担 更多具备实际经济价值的任务 ，这一领域通常被称为具身智能。 高阳指出，“大脑”确实是整个机器人技术栈中最薄弱的一环。“我们预计到 2027 年年中达到‘GPT-3.0’级的里程碑。届时， 你可以直接用自然语言与机器人交流，它会执行一系列合理的物理动作，尝试完成任务 。” 报道指出，整个机器人行业都在等待自己的“ChatGPT 时刻”：足以 把前沿技术变成面向广大客户的实用产品 的软件突破。OpenAI 在 2022 年推出 ChatGPT 后，生成式 AI 迅速进入大众市场，同时证明了商业化潜力。 IT之家从报道中获悉，为了训练机器人，千寻智能在全国安排 约 1000 名合同人员收集真实世界数据 。目前，千寻智能的机器人在结构化客厅环境中 完成简单任务的成功率达到 90% 。 高阳预计：“未来一两年将是工业应用的初始窗口。两年后，我们会看到机器人进入商业服务场景，执行较简单的任务。相比…
items.summary_en: Gao Yang, co-founder and chief scientist of Qianxun Intelligence and a Tsinghua robotics professor, expects humanoid robots to follow spoken instructions and handle most general tasks as early as next year, but says household usefulness is further off. He calls the robot "brain" the weakest link and targets a "GPT-3.0-level" milestone by mid-2027, supported by roughly 1,000 contract workers collecting real-world data.
items.why_zh: 行业正等待机器人自己的"ChatGPT时刻"，软件而非硬件成为具身智能竞争的关键。
items.why_en: The industry is awaiting robotics' own "ChatGPT moment," making software, not hardware, the key battleground in embodied AI.

items.summary_en: Beijing's economy and IT bureau released "Ten Measures for the Token Economy" and a 2026–2028 action plan to cultivate a new intelligent-economy form around tokens. The plan calls for graded standards for token factories, core tech breakthroughs in models and chips, a token quality evaluation system and a token distribution platform.
items.why_zh: 地方政府把"词元"作为产业政策抓手，体现出算力与模型供给正被纳入基础设施式规划。
items.why_en: Treating tokens as a policy lever shows local governments now plan compute and model supply as infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 智谱 ZCode 被质疑“偷传代码”：官方回应称问题已修复，将开源代码库、引入第三方审查
items.title_en: Zhipu Apologizes Over ZCode Codebase Uploads, Says Issue Fixed and Will Open-Source the Tool
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 18 日消息，针对社区中有关代码库数据上传的讨论，智谱旗下编程产品 ZCode 今天（18 日）通过智谱官方群组向受影响用户致歉，并发布回应称 已第一时间完成自查，相关问题目前已经修复 。 IT之家从官方的回应获悉，此次问题源于 ZCode 的“代码库索引”功能 ，该功能旨在帮助用户在本地生成仓库索引，以支持包括历史版本在内的会话检查点恢复、历史版本回退及 Repo Wiki（代码仓库知识库）等功能。 Repo Wiki 功能在生成 Wiki 页面（知识库页面）时， 可能会触发仓库数据上传 。Wiki 页面在云端生成后，相关上传数据会立即销毁，不会保存。由于该功能在上线初期默认开启，导致部分用户受到影响。 针对外界对数据安全及产品信任的关注，官方宣布近期将开源 ZCode 代码库，并邀请第三方评估人员对系统运行情况进行审查，持续公开产品审查进展，以更加透明的方式建立用户信任。 官方还将为全体用户 额外提供一次周额度重置 ，今（18 日）起发放。
items.summary_en: Zhipu apologized to affected users after its coding product ZCode was accused of uploading repository data, saying the issue has been fixed. The company traced it to the Repo Wiki feature in its codebase indexing system, which could trigger uploads when generating cloud wiki pages, with data destroyed immediately and the feature on by default at launch. Zhipu will open-source ZCode's codebase, invite third-party review and reset weekly quotas for all users.
items.why_zh: 开发者工具的数据边界与信任问题，正成为 AI 编程产品能否被企业采用的关键考验。
items.why_en: Data boundaries and trust in developer tools are becoming a make-or-break test for enterprise adoption of AI coding products.

items.why_en: Whether user data is retained is central to trust in AI tools, and public commitments plus outside audits are both needed.

items.title_en: Transcriptomic Models for Immunotherapy Response Prediction Show Limited Cross-cohort Generalisability
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文系统评测了九个当前最先进的转录组免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）应答预测模型，考察它们在跨队列场景下的泛化表现。研究背景是：ICI 已改变癌症治疗格局，但仍有相当比例患者存在原发或获得性耐药，因此治疗前的准确应答预测仍是未被满足的临床需求。基于 bulk RNA 测序与单细胞测序（scRNA-seq）的转录组生物标志物被视为捕捉肿瘤—免疫互作的重要途径，但这些模型在不同队列间的可迁移性此前并不清楚。论文的结论是：现有模型的跨队列泛化能力有限。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.05478v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have transformed cancer therapy; yet substantial proportion of patients exhibit intrinsic or acquired resistance, making accurate pre-treatment response prediction a critical unmet need. Transcriptomics-based biomarkers derived from bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) offer a promising avenue for capturing tumour-immune interactions, yet the cross-cohort generalisability of existing prediction models remains unclear.We systematically benchmark nine state-of-the-art transcriptomic ICI respo…
items.why_zh: 它提示现有免疫治疗应答预测模型在真实跨人群场景中可能并不可靠，为临床转化敲响警钟。
items.why_en: It warns that current immunotherapy response prediction models may not transfer reliably to real-world, cross-cohort settings, tempering clinical expectations.

items.why_zh: 多模态竞争正从能力展示转向实际任务落地，这决定了模型能否真正进入日常工作流。
items.why_en: Multimodal competition is shifting from capability demos to real task execution, which determines whether models enter everyday workflows.

items.title_zh: 9个月融资755亿！智谱疯狂“吸血”背后，谁在为万亿泡沫买单？
items.title_en: 75.5 Billion Yuan in Nine Months: Who Is Paying for Zhipu's Funding Frenzy?
items.summary_zh: 9个月融资755亿！智谱疯狂“吸血”背后，谁在为万亿泡沫买单？ 财富号
items.summary_en: A Caifuhao article examines Zhipu's reported 75.5 billion yuan of fundraising in nine months, asking who ultimately bears the risk behind such massive AI bets. It frames the question as whether this reflects industrial certainty or an inflating valuation bubble.
items.why_zh: 巨额融资的速度与规模，直接关系到AI行业估值是否存在系统性泡沫。
items.why_en: The speed and scale of mega-fundraising bear directly on whether AI valuations are forming a systemic bubble.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek新模型上线，长文本缓存硬盘占用暴降88%
items.title_en: DeepSeek's New Model Cuts Long-Context Cache Disk Usage by 88%
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek新模型上线，长文本缓存硬盘占用暴降88% thepaper.cn
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has released a new model that cuts the disk footprint of long-context caching by 88%, according to The Paper. The reduction eases storage and memory pressure for long-context inference, lowering deployment costs.
items.why_zh: 缓存开销是长上下文推理的主要成本瓶颈，大幅压缩它能让长文本能力在服务端更可行。
items.why_en: Cache overhead is a core cost bottleneck for long-context inference, so shrinking it makes long-context serving far more practical.

items.title_zh: 纽森下令组建加州AI专家组，研究“终止开关”与新安全监管
items.title_en: Newsom order forms California AI panel to study "kill switch" creation, new safety regulations
items.summary_zh: 据 CBS News 报道，加州州长加文·纽森签署行政令，组建一个加州人工智能专家组，研究设立“终止开关”（kill switch）以及新的安全监管规则。该小组的任务聚焦于AI系统的安全可控性问题，包括在必要时关停模型的能力。此举使加州在州层面推进AI安全治理上再进一步，也可能对在加州运营的AI企业产生合规影响。
items.summary_en: Newsom order forms California AI panel to study "kill switch" creation, new safety regulations CBS News
items.why_zh: 州级行政令可能成为AI安全监管的先行样本，影响企业的模型部署与合规策略。
items.why_en: A state-level order could become an early template for AI safety regulation, shaping how companies deploy and comply.

items.title_zh: 家族办公室争相涌入AI投资，是长期转向还是又一轮周期？
items.title_en: Family offices are clamoring for AI investments
items.summary_zh: 有报道指出，家族办公室正争相配置人工智能相关投资，AI 已成为这类私人财富管理机构重点关注的方向。不过报道同时提出一个值得追问的问题：这种热情究竟代表资产配置的结构性、永久性转变，还是又一次熟悉的投资周期。文章并未给出定论，而是把判断留给了周期与回报的后续验证。
items.summary_en: Whether it's a permanent shift or part of a familiar cycle is worth asking, though.
items.why_zh: 家族办公室代表长期耐心资本，其配置取向可反映AI资产是结构性趋势还是阶段性热度。
items.why_en: Family offices represent long-term patient capital, so their allocation choices reveal whether AI is a structural trend or a passing cycle.

items.title_zh: Spanberger 公布弗吉尼亚州数据中心框架并成立 AI 工作组
items.title_en: Spanberger announces Virginia data center framework and AI task force
items.summary_zh: 据 WJLA 报道，Spanberger 宣布推出弗吉尼亚州数据中心框架，并宣布组建人工智能工作组。该框架意在为州内数据中心相关事务提供政策指引，AI 工作组则聚焦人工智能治理议题。报道未披露框架的具体条款、工作组的成员构成以及后续时间表。这一动作表明，弗吉尼亚州正着手回应数据中心快速扩张与 AI 发展带来的政策需求。
items.summary_en: Spanberger announces Virginia data center framework and AI task force WJLA
items.why_zh: 弗吉尼亚州是美国数据中心最集中的地区之一，其政策取向可能影响全美 AI 基础设施布局。
items.why_en: Virginia is home to one of the largest concentrations of US data centers, so its policy direction could shape AI infrastructure nationwide.

items.title_zh: 加州州长纽森设立 AI 安全监管小组，提及可能的“终止开关”
items.title_en: California Gov. Gavin Newsom creates panel on AI safety regulation, suggests possible 'kill switch'
items.summary_zh: 据 Hanford Sentinel 报道，加州州长加文·纽森设立了一个负责 AI 安全监管议题的小组，并在相关表态中提到可能引入“终止开关”机制。此举被视为加州在 AI 监管上进一步推进的动作之一。报道未说明该小组的成员构成、职权范围或“终止开关”的具体设想与落地路径。
items.summary_en: California Gov. Gavin Newsom creates panel on AI safety regulation, suggests possible 'kill switch' Hanford Sentinel
items.why_zh: 加州是美国 AI 产业核心地带，其监管探索常被视为其他州乃至联邦立法的风向标。
items.why_en: California is a hub of the US AI industry, so its regulatory moves are often seen as a bellwether for other states and federal lawmakers.

items.title_zh: 美官员：中伊及以色列团体利用中国开源AI模型发动未见的社媒影响力运动
items.title_en: US officials: China, Iran and Israel-linked groups used Chinese open-source AI models in social media influence campaigns
items.summary_zh: 美官员：中伊及以色列团体利用中国开源AI模型发动未见的社媒影响力运动 RFI
items.summary_en: US officials say groups linked to China, Iran and Israel used Chinese open-source AI models to run social media influence campaigns of a kind not seen before, according to RFI. No specific models, platforms or campaign scale were detailed in the summary.
items.why_zh: 这凸显开源大模型可能被用于跨境信息操弄，或将推动对模型开放策略与出口的更严审视。
items.why_en: It highlights how open-source AI models can be repurposed for cross-border information operations, potentially fueling tighter scrutiny of model openness and exports.

items.title_zh: 纽森签署行政令，加快 AI 监管并推动建立“终止开关”
items.title_en: Newsom signs executive order to speed up AI regulations and creation of ‘kill switch’
items.summary_zh: 据《旧金山纪事报》报道，加州州长加文·纽森签署行政令，意在加快人工智能监管进程，并推动建立所谓的“终止开关”。行政令的具体条文、适用对象与实施时间表未在摘要中说明。此举是加州在 AI 治理领域的最新动作，与其此前设立 AI 安全监管小组的方向一致。
items.summary_en: Newsom signs executive order to speed up AI regulations and creation of ‘kill switch’ San Francisco Chronicle
items.why_zh: 以行政令推进 AI 监管，可能为加州乃至其他地区确立可复制的治理路径。
items.why_en: Using an executive order to advance AI regulation could establish a replicable governance path for California and beyond.

items.title_zh: AI手机下半场竞争开启，豆包手机助手为何先问App意见
items.title_en: As the AI phone race enters its next phase, why Doubao's phone assistant asks apps first
items.summary_zh: AI手机下半场竞争开启，豆包手机助手为何先问App意见 21财经
items.summary_en: Coverage from 21 Finance examines the next phase of competition in AI phones, focusing on why ByteDance's Doubao phone assistant checks with apps before acting on a user's behalf. The article explores the reasons behind that approach, though further technical and commercial details were not provided in the summary.
items.why_zh: AI 助手能否跨应用代用户操作，是 AI 手机竞争中最关键的权限与生态规则问题。
items.why_en: Whether AI assistants can act across apps on a user's behalf is the key permissions and ecosystem battleground in the AI phone race.

items.title_zh: Meta 的 Muse 登陆 Mac，可代用户在电脑上执行操作
items.title_en: Meta’s Muse hits Mac, letting the AI take actions on your computer
items.summary_zh: Meta 的 AI 产品 Muse 现已登陆 Mac 平台。据介绍，Muse 可以在 Mac 上与用户的文件和应用程序协同工作，并代表用户执行操作。这意味着 Muse 从单纯的对话式助手，向能够直接操作本地环境、代为完成任务的形态延伸。官方未在摘要中说明具体支持的 App 范围或权限机制。
items.summary_en: Muse is now available on the Mac, where it can work with your files and apps to take action on your behalf.
items.why_zh: AI 助手从“对话”走向“代操作”，是各家争夺桌面端 Agent 入口的重要一步。
items.why_en: Moving from chat to taking actions marks a key step in the race for the desktop AI agent layer.

items.title_zh: 华盛顿备忘录：AI 末日论者与明尼苏达农民游说国会
items.title_en: D.C. Memo: AI doomers, Minnesota farmers lobby Congress
items.summary_zh: 据 MinnPost 的“华盛顿备忘录”栏目报道，本期内容涉及被称为“AI 末日论者”的群体，以及明尼苏达州农民在国会的游说活动。栏目以华盛顿政策动态为线索，将 AI 风险争论与农业团体的国会游说并列呈现。摘要未披露具体人物、主张或游说诉求等细节。
items.summary_en: D.C. Memo: AI doomers, Minnesota farmers lobby Congress MinnPost
items.why_zh: 把 AI 风险争论与农业游说放在同一政策视野下，反映华盛顿议题版图正被 AI 议题重塑。
items.why_en: Pairing AI risk debates with farm lobbying shows how AI is reshaping the policy agenda in Washington.

items.title_zh: 纽森设立 AI 安全监管小组，并提及可能的“终止开关”
items.title_en: Newsom creates panel on AI safety regulation, suggests possible ‘kill switch’
items.summary_zh: 据《洛杉矶时报》报道，加州州长加文·纽森设立了一个聚焦 AI 安全监管的小组，并提出可能引入“终止开关”的设想。报道显示，加州正试图在 AI 安全与监管框架上先行一步。摘要未说明小组的人员组成、工作方式，也未交代“终止开关”具体指向何种机制。
items.summary_en: Newsom creates panel on AI safety regulation, suggests possible ‘kill switch’ Los Angeles Times
items.why_zh: 在联邦立法进展迟缓之际，州层面的 AI 安全探索可能成为美国 AI 监管的实际试验场。
items.why_en: With federal legislation stalled, state-level AI safety efforts may become the de facto testing ground for US AI regulation.

items.title_zh: 谷歌与 NASA 推出 AI 模型，从太空监测甲烷排放
items.title_en: Google, NASA launch AI model to map methane emissions from space
items.summary_zh: 谷歌与美国国家航空航天局（NASA）联合发布了一款人工智能模型，用于从太空追踪和绘制甲烷排放情况。甲烷是主要的强效温室气体之一，其排放点位分散、难以定位，卫星遥感结合 AI 分析被认为有望提升监测效率。该工具的推出意味着甲烷排放的识别与归因可能变得更加可及，为气候监管、企业排放核查和环保组织的监督提供新的技术手段。目前公开信息有限，模型的覆盖范围与精度尚待进一步披露。
items.summary_en: Google, NASA launch AI model to map methane emissions from space Waste Dive
items.why_zh: 甲烷是强效温室气体，太空 AI 监测若能落地，将显著提升排放透明度与追责能力。
items.why_en: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas, and space-based AI monitoring could make emissions far more transparent and attributable.

items.title_zh: Tether 以开源机器翻译模型应对非洲 AI 投入不足
items.title_en: Tether addresses AI underinvestment in Africa with open-source machine translation models
items.summary_zh: 稳定币发行商 Tether 推出开源机器翻译模型，意在应对非洲地区在人工智能领域投入不足的问题。报道显示，该举措希望以开放可用的语言技术降低当地获取 AI 能力的门槛，服务多语种的沟通与本地化需求。此举也反映出加密与金融科技企业正把开源 AI 作为切入新兴市场、扩大生态影响力的路径。具体的语言覆盖范围与模型性能在已知信息中尚未详细说明。
items.summary_en: Tether addresses AI underinvestment in Africa with open-source machine translation models cio.com
items.why_zh: 开源语言模型有望缩小非洲在多语种 AI 能力上的差距，也显示加密企业对 AI 基建的介入。
items.why_en: Open-source language models could narrow Africa's multilingual AI gap, while showing crypto firms moving into AI infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 阿里巴巴开源可检测癌症及近 150 种病症的 AI 模型
items.title_en: Alibaba open-sources AI model that can detect cancer and nearly 150 conditions
items.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴开源了一款人工智能模型，据报可识别癌症以及近 150 种疾病或健康状况。把此类医疗 AI 模型开源，意味着研究机构、医院和开发者可在此基础上进行验证、微调与本地化部署，而不必从零训练。这一动向也折射出中国科技公司在医疗 AI 领域的开放策略与竞争布局。已知信息未披露模型的具体模态、训练数据规模与临床验证结果。
items.summary_en: Alibaba open-sources AI model that can detect cancer and nearly 150 conditions South China Morning Post
items.why_zh: 医疗 AI 开源可降低诊断技术的使用门槛，但真正价值取决于后续的临床验证与落地效果。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing medical AI can lower barriers to diagnostic tools, though its value hinges on clinical validation and real-world deployment.

items.title_zh: 美国州级监管机构为银行提供 AI 检查手册，联邦层面仍存空白
items.title_en: State Regulators Give Banks an AI Exam Playbook as Federal Gap Persists
items.summary_zh: 美国州级金融监管机构向银行发布了一套针对人工智能的检查或评估指引，相当于为银行应对 AI 相关的合规审查提供了“考试手册”。报道指出，在联邦层面相关规则尚未明确、存在监管空白的背景下，州级监管者先行一步，为银行在模型治理、风险管理和合规审查方面给出操作框架。这可能促使银行按州级标准先行调整 AI 使用方式，同时也带来州与联邦标准不统一的问题。
items.summary_en: State Regulators Give Banks an AI Exam Playbook as Federal Gap Persists PYMNTS.com
items.why_zh: 在联邦规则缺位时，州级指引实际上会成为银行 AI 合规的现实标准，影响行业实践。
items.why_en: With federal rules absent, state guidance may effectively become the de facto compliance standard for banks using AI.

items.title_zh: 美国 AI 巨头提议开发减速，欧洲同行和政界并不认同
items.title_en: US AI giants call for slowing development, but European peers and policymakers push back
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 18 日消息，据路透社今天（18 日）报道，此前，阿莫迪、奥尔特曼和马斯克先后发出警告，能力不断增强的 AI 系统可能带来风险，故有必要 控制其发展节奏 ，但欧洲企业和官员对此表现出明显怀疑。 法国初创企业 Mistral 在声明中指出，这些风险早在几个月前就已十分明确了。“一些现有市场参与者开始 利用这一时机巩固市场地位 ，推动制定 更有利于自己、而不利于竞争对手 的监管规定。” 欧洲拥有的前沿 AI 开发商数量有限，成立仅 3 年的 Mistral 被视为欧洲自主打造前沿 AI 模型、挑战中美主导地位的最大希望。 现阶段，欧洲高度依赖 OpenAI、Anthropic 和微软开发的模型，因此不少企业和业内人士 对继续依赖美国科技公司保持警惕 。 瑞士隐私软件企业 Proton COO 拉斐尔 · 奥凡在巴黎一场科技活动上直言：“我认为，这完全是在为自己谋利。他们只是想继续维持外界对其服务的依赖。” 德国 AI 初创企业 Black Forest Labs 公共政策负责人本 · 布鲁克斯警告，如果依据人为设定的门槛，强行拉开大型 AI 实验室和新进入者之间的差距，“将会 打击前沿或接近前沿领域的开放创新 ”。 不过，同样身为美国企业的 Hugging Face CEO 克莱芒 · 德朗格表态反对为 AI 开发踩刹车。“现在不是放慢速度的时候，而是应该加速。”同时…
items.summary_en: Reuters reports that Anthropic's Dario Amodei, OpenAI's Sam Altman and Elon Musk have warned about risks from increasingly capable AI and the need to control its pace. European firms and officials are skeptical: Mistral says incumbents are using the moment to entrench themselves and shape favorable regulation. Proton's COO called it self-serving, while Hugging Face's CEO argued for speeding up rather than slowing down.
items.why_zh: “是否该给 AI 开发设限”正演变为一场涉及监管话语权与市场竞争格局的博弈。
items.why_en: Whether to throttle AI development is becoming a battle over regulatory influence and competitive positioning.

items.title_zh: As tech honchos call for regulation, AI policy has largely stalled
items.title_en: As tech honchos call for regulation, AI policy has largely stalled
items.summary_zh: As tech honchos call for regulation, AI policy has largely stalled Detroit Free Press
items.summary_en: Even as tech leaders publicly call for AI regulation, actual policy progress has largely stalled. The gap highlights how far rhetoric is from legislation and rulemaking, which are slowed by politics, lobbying and design difficulties. The delay leaves both risk governance and industry expectations unsettled.
items.why_zh: 呼吁与立法脱节意味着 AI 风险治理被拖延，行业将在规则不确定性中长期运行。
items.why_en: A gap between calls for rules and actual lawmaking leaves AI risk governance delayed and industry operating in uncertainty.

items.title_zh: 全球 AI 竞赛与生存性风险：多极合作的必要性
items.title_en: Global AI Race and Existential Risks: The Need for Multipolar Cooperation
items.summary_zh: 该评论文章聚焦全球人工智能竞赛所伴随的生存性风险，主张以多极合作的方式来应对。文章的核心关切是：在多个国家与阵营竞相推进前沿 AI 的格局下，单纯的技术与地缘竞争可能放大失控风险，因此需要跨国家、跨阵营的协调机制。其论点呼应了近年来关于 AI 安全治理应超越单一国家主导的讨论。原文未在摘要中给出具体政策方案细节。
items.summary_en: Global AI Race and Existential Risks: The Need for Multipolar Cooperation China-US Focus
items.why_zh: 在 AI 竞赛加剧的背景下，多极协调被视为降低全球性失控风险的必要路径。
items.why_en: As the AI race intensifies, multipolar coordination is framed as essential to reducing global loss-of-control risks.

items.title_zh: “AI 教父”辛顿参与联署公开信：科技巨头应保证第三方评估人员工作无干预、受保护
items.title_en: Hinton and others sign open letter demanding protections for third-party AI evaluators
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 18 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天（18 日）晚间报道，由多家监督组织组成的 AI 评估机构论坛发布了一封公开信，为第三方风险评估划出一套最低条件，认为 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 等 AI 实验室只有满足特定的要求，才能与外部评估机构开展更有效的合作。 公开信获得数十名 AI 领域人士联署，包括“AI 教父”计算机科学先驱杰弗里 · 辛顿和斯图尔特 · 罗素。 本周，网络上对 AI 风险的担忧迅速升温。Anthropic CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫迪和 OpenAI CEO 萨姆 · 奥尔特曼此前都承诺向第三方评估人员开放公司内部资源并评估 AI 风险，获得与员工同等级别的信息访问权限。 AI 评估机构论坛的公开信正是对此作出回应。“要具备公信力，驻场第三方评估人员 必须保持科学客观性、透明度和独立性，并得到充分保护，免受被评估企业干预 。” IT之家获悉，论坛认为，第三方评估人员不仅应获准公开透明地开展工作，还应能够直接与公司董事会及其他拥有特殊监督权限的机构沟通，不受企业过滤或限制，并有权公开发布评估结果。 这些评估人员还应受到保护， 避免因评估工作遭到 AI 实验室报复 ，同时获得与企业内部评估人员相同的系统、数据、工具和实体场所访问权限。 公开信还主张，每家 AI 实验室都应 引入观点和专业背景不同的评估人员 ，以覆盖生物科学风险、AI 失控风险等…
items.summary_en: An open letter from a forum of AI evaluation organizations sets minimum conditions for third-party risk assessment at labs such as Anthropic and OpenAI, and has been signed by dozens of figures including Geoffrey Hinton and Stuart Russell. It says resident evaluators must be objective, independent and free from company interference, able to talk directly to boards and publish findings, and protected from retaliation.
items.why_zh: 第三方评估若缺乏独立性，AI 风险承诺就难以取信于人，这封信试图把“可信评估”的最低标准写清楚。
items.why_en: Without independence, third-party evaluation of AI risk is hard to trust; the letter tries to define minimum credibility standards.

items.title_zh: MiniMax Code CLI 正式开源，在评测中取得 76.7% 的任务通过率
items.title_en: MiniMax Code CLI Goes Open Source, Achieving 76.7% Task Pass Rate in Evaluation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 18 日消息，MiniMax 今晚宣布， MiniMax Code CLI 的 v0.4.12 版本面向全球开发者正式开放，并且以 MIT 协议正式开放源代码 。 据介绍，MiniMax Code CLI 是 MiniMax Code 客户端的核心组件。在基于 FrontierHarness Eval 的本轮评测中，取得了 76.7% 的任务通过率，成功任务耗时中位数为 4 分 33 秒， 两项指标均优于报告所列公开基线 。 官方表示，希望通过开源，让开发者能够审视工具调用和权限处理，构建可靠的企业级应用。也让社区参与发现问题、贡献修复。让使用更放心，让安全机制在实际使用和审查中持续完善。 IT之家附相关链接： 快速体验： curl -fsSL https://filecdn.minimax.chat/public/install.sh | bash Github 源码： https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/minimax-code 客户端下载： https://agent.minimax.cn/download
items.summary_en: MiniMax released MiniMax Code CLI v0.4.12 under the MIT license, opening the core component of its MiniMax Code client to developers. It scored a 76.7% task pass rate on FrontierHarness Eval, with a median successful-task time of 4 minutes 33 seconds, both beating listed public baselines.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 18 日消息，过去两年，甲骨文花费数十亿美元帮助其他企业运行 AI。然而相比之下，自家公司全面引入 AI 的时间却晚得多。 据《商业内幕》今天（18 日）晚间报道，甲骨文联合 CEO 克莱 · 马古尔克在内部员工大会上坦言，直到去年， 公司还没有找到让生成式 AI 在整个员工队伍中真正发挥作用的方法 。 ChatGPT 和 Codex 投入使用后，甲骨文员工编写代码的速度大幅提升，同时也 把原本隐藏在其他环节的瓶颈暴露了出来 。马古尔克说：“回想一年前的情况，我觉得当时我们还没弄明白，怎样才能真正让 AI 对我们自己这么有用。” 去年，甲骨文尝试把 AI 用于客户支持，但开发、财务和销售等部门还没有大范围应用。甲骨文首席信息官杰伊 · 埃文斯告诉员工，转折出现在今年 4 月和 5 月，公司开始部署 ChatGPT Enterprise 和 Codex 的时候。 甲骨文没有简单地把工具开放给员工，而是同步制定公司标准、安全控制措施和内部政策，三个月内使用率便达到 80%。“我们把这些工具做得太容易上手了，结果可能多少会被成本吓到。” 甲骨文因此建立了内部监控机制，可以查看员工使用哪些模型，以及分别产生多少费用。 埃文斯指出，OpenAI GPT-6 Astra 的 使用成本达到其他模型的 2.5 倍 ，而许多任务并不需要调用如此昂贵的模型。例如，日常工作就可以交给成…
items.summary_en: Oracle has spent billions over the past two years helping other companies run AI, but The Business Insider reports its own company-wide adoption came much later. Co-CEO Clay Magouyrk admitted Oracle had not figured out how to make generative AI truly useful across its workforce until last year. After deploying ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex starting in April and May, usage reached 80% in three months; Oracle also set up monitoring to track model use and costs, with CIO Jay Evans noting that OpenAI GPT-6 Astra costs 2.5 times more than other models.
items.why_zh: 连AI基础设施供应商自身也面临落地和成本治理难题，说明企业AI转型不仅靠工具开放，还需标准、安全和成本控制。
items.why_en: Even an AI infrastructure provider struggles with adoption and cost governance, showing enterprise AI transformation requires standards, security, and cost controls.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 18 日消息，路透社今天（18 日）晚间援引知情人士消息称，Anthropic 在旧金山湾区低调建立了一座湿实验室，把 AI 业务进一步延伸到 需要实际动手操作的生物学研究和药物科学领域 。 知情人士透露，在公众对 AI 风险愈发担忧之际，Anthropic 开始在湿实验室进行实体实验。Anthropic 此前提出，希望借助 AI 推动罕见病治疗方法的发展 ，公司的生物学研究也从“计算机模拟”和计算机评估进一步走向真实实验。 IT之家注：湿实验室是一个科学概念，与“干实验室”相对。相比干实验室，湿实验室在实验中需要 用到较多的化学试剂 。相比之下，干实验室则注重 通过各种仪器进行计算 ，以归纳出实验材料的物理模型。 Anthropic 生命科学负责人埃里克 · 考德勒-艾布拉姆斯证实了湿实验室的存在。“我们认为，生物学研究最终还是要 接受真实实验室工作的检验 ，而且未来一段时间都会如此。我们现在确实在做这些工作。整体模式和大多数生物科技公司类似，一部分在自己的设施里完成，另一部分则与外部合作伙伴共同开展。” Anthropic 发言人又进一步补充，这座实验室 并非专门用于药物发现 ，并拒绝进一步说明具体用途。 知情人士称，建立湿实验室只是 Anthropic 迈向更大目标的一小步。Anthropic 希望攻克其认为制药行业忽视的疾病，公司也希望 在员工和公众失去对…
items.summary_en: Reuters reports Anthropic has quietly set up a wet lab in the San Francisco Bay Area, moving its biology work from in-silico modeling toward hands-on experiments. Its life sciences lead confirmed the lab follows a biotech-style model, though a spokesperson said it is not dedicated to drug discovery.
items.why_zh: 一家头部 AI 实验室从“纯计算”走向真实实验，显示 AI 正加速渗入生物医药实体研发。
items.why_en: A leading AI lab moving from pure computation into physical experiments shows AI pushing deeper into real drug R&D.

items.title_zh: 腾讯 WorkBuddy 5.5.6 上线全栈网页应用生成能力，自带云数据库、文件存储、注册登录和 AI 调用
items.title_en: Tencent WorkBuddy 5.5.6 Adds Full-Stack Web App Generation with Cloud Database and Login
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 18 日消息，腾讯 WorkBuddy 宣布，WorkBuddy 5.5.6 上线全栈「应用」生成能力，首期支持全栈网页应用生成： 自带云数据库、文件存储、注册登录和 AI 调用 ，免部署，发布即用。 据介绍，WorkBuddy 全栈「网页应用」生成，包括以下核心能力： 一站式制作发布： 页面生成、数据配置、上线发布闭环在 WorkBuddy 免部署： 不用买服务器、不配环境，发布即得访问链接 云数据库： 结构化数据存云端，支持增删改查，可配权限规则控制谁能读写 文件存储： 图片、附件等文件上传到云端并在应用内调用 注册登录： 内置身份认证，用户可注册登录，数据按用户隔离 免密钥 AI 调用： 直接调用大模型，不用自己申请和管理 API Key 运营数据统计： 上线后可查看用户数量、注册增长 IT之家注意到，随着 WorkBuddy 的资料库与「应用」（使用到云服务能力的应用）生成能力的上线，WorkBuddy 国内个人版会员权益随之调整。升级后会员权益如下： 主要变化如下： 新增权益项“资料库的存储空间” ，免费用户可拥有累计 5G 资料库容量空间，付费用户可拥有更高资料库存储空间。 新增云服务相关权益项 。WorkBuddy 的「应用」可按需开启云服务，不同会员版本可开启云服务的应用个数不同。应用开启云服务后，运行会消耗「云服务资源点」，消耗量主要与该云应用的…
items.summary_en: Tencent's WorkBuddy 5.5.6 introduces full-stack web app generation with a built-in cloud database, file storage, sign-up/login and AI model calls — no deployment needed, just publish and get a link. Membership perks were also adjusted, with free users getting 5GB of library storage and cloud services consuming resource points.
items.why_zh: 把数据库、存储、认证和大模型调用打包进免部署工具，意味着 AI 生成的应用正从“演示”走向可直接运营的产品。
items.why_en: Bundling database, storage, auth and model calls into a no-deploy tool moves AI app generation from demo to production.

items.title_zh: 小鹏 GX 上新 「新月银」车色，上市 4 个月累计交付破 2.5 万台
items.title_en: Xpeng GX Adds 'Crescent Silver' Color, Deliveries Surpass 25,000 Units in Four Months

items.summary_en: Xpeng has introduced a new 'Crescent Silver' color for its GX flagship SUV. Launched on May 20 with prices from 279,800 to 359,800 yuan, the GX has surpassed 25,000 cumulative deliveries in four months and ranked in the top three for large SUVs above 300,000 yuan for two consecutive months. It offers both battery-electric and range-extender powertrains, with the EREV version delivering 430 km of electric range.
items.why_zh: 小鹏GX的交付表现显示中国高端新能源SUV市场竞争激烈，智能座舱与AI配置成为关键卖点。
items.why_en: Xpeng GX's delivery milestone highlights fierce competition in China's premium electric SUV market, where smart cockpit and AI features are key selling points.

items.why_en: The move into desktop AI coding tools pits Moonshot AI against GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and other developer-focused assistants.

items.summary_en: SoftBank has increased its credit line to $6.5 billion as its AI-related debts mount, according to Bloomberg. The move could provide more liquidity for its continued AI investments. It highlights the growing financing needs and leverage risks behind the AI investment boom.

items.title_zh: “中国第一展”第 140 届广交会 10 月 15 日开幕，电子消费品成为绝对主力
items.title_en: 140th Canton Fair Opens Oct 15, Electronics Become the Main Force
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 18 日消息，国务院新闻办公室今天（9 月 18 日）下午举行新闻发布会，商务部和广东有关负责人介绍第 140 届中国进出口商品交易会（广交会）有关情况。 会上介绍，第 140 届广交会将于 10 月 15 日至 11 月 4 日分三期在广州举办。本届广交会将迎来创办 70 周年的重要时点。70 年来，广交会历经风雨洗礼、跨越沧海桑田，从首届的 9600 平方米、1200 名采购商发展到现在 155 万平方米、31 万名采购商，整整 140 届从未间断。已经成为我国规模最大、历史最长、商品最全、客商最多、成交最好的国际贸易盛会， 是享誉全球的“中国第一展” 。 今年 1-8 月，机电产品占我国进出口比重达 55%，较去年全年提升 2.5 个百分点。电子元器件、工业机器人、3D 打印机以及新能源汽车等表现亮眼，成为拉动外贸增长的新动能。本届广交会顺应外贸向新趋势，3.2 万家参展企业当中，专精特新、单项冠军等优质企业超过 1.1 万家。 64% 的参展企业应用工业互联网、人工智能等新技术 。展出的新产品和绿色产品占比分别达到 23.2%、26%，都创下历史新高。 本届广交会进一步提高数字化、智能化水平，将人工智能、大数据等技术深度嵌入办展全过程，首次推出 22 个智慧应用场景和 16 项 AI 特色应用， 在国内展览业率先实现全馆展位级导航和展位 AR 信息展示 ，…
items.summary_en: The 140th Canton Fair will run from Oct 15 to Nov 4 in Guangzhou, marking the 70th anniversary of the trade event. Electronics are a major focus, with 64% of exhibitors using AI and industrial internet technologies. The fair debuts 22 smart application scenarios and 16 AI-powered features, including venue-wide booth-level navigation and AR information displays.
items.why_zh: 广交会大规模嵌入AI与数字化技术，显示AI正成为外贸新动能和展会服务升级的核心。
items.why_en: The Canton Fair's extensive use of AI and digital tools shows AI is becoming a key driver of foreign trade and exhibition innovation.

items.title_zh: 商务部：中国人工智能大模型全球累计下载量突破100亿次

items.why_en: AI phones are emerging as the new battleground, and explosive sales show growing consumer demand for on-device AI.

items.why_en: Inference speed directly shapes the experience and cost of real-time AI applications, making it a key battleground for model makers.

items.summary_zh: 据 Artificial Lawyer 报道，OpenAI 推出了面向法律行业的 Astra 产品。报道未披露该产品的具体功能清单、定价方案、可用地区或上线时间等细节。从命名与定位看，Astra 是 OpenAI 针对法律这一垂直专业场景推出的专门化方案。法律行业长期被视为大模型落地的高价值场景之一，此举意味着 OpenAI 正进一步向专业服务市场渗透，与已有的法律科技产品形成直接竞争。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Launches Astra For Law Artificial Lawyer
items.why_zh: 法律是付费能力强、专业门槛高的垂直市场，OpenAI 入场将直接冲击现有法律科技格局。
items.why_en: Legal is a high-value, high-barrier vertical, so OpenAI's entry directly pressures existing legal-tech players.

items.title_en: Zhipu Releases GLM-5.3-FlashX Model With Up to 200 Tokens/s Inference

items.summary_en: Zhipu has released GLM-5.3-FlashX, claiming inference speeds of up to 200 tokens/s. The high-speed variant of the GLM-5.3 family targets low-latency, high-concurrency workloads such as real-time dialogue and agent applications.
items.why_zh: 高速推理版本是企业级大规模调用能否跑通成本账的关键一环。
items.why_en: A high-speed inference variant is central to making large-scale enterprise deployments economically viable.

items.title_zh: 里昂：智谱上调年底ARR指引至30亿美元 给予“跑赢大市”评级
items.title_en: CLSA Lifts Zhipu's Year-End ARR Guidance to US$3 Billion, Rates It 'Outperform'
items.summary_zh: 里昂：智谱上调年底ARR指引至30亿美元 给予“跑赢大市”评级 新浪财经
items.summary_en: CLSA has raised Zhipu's year-end ARR guidance to US$3 billion and assigned an 'outperform' rating, signaling a more optimistic view of the company's revenue trajectory amid its GLM-5.3 rollout and pricing changes.
items.why_zh: 券商对 ARR 指引与评级的调整，是观察大模型公司商业化兑现度的重要外部信号。
items.why_en: Analyst moves on ARR guidance and ratings offer a key external signal of how well a model company is monetizing.

items.title_zh: 在 AI「囤粮潮」里，拆解智谱 50 亿美元的「技术账本」
items.title_en: Inside Zhipu's US$5 Billion 'Tech Ledger' Amid the AI Stockpiling Wave
items.summary_zh: 在 AI「囤粮潮」里，拆解智谱 50 亿美元的「技术账本」 雷峰网
items.summary_en: Leiphone examines Zhipu's 'tech ledger' around the US$5 billion figure, set against the industry-wide scramble to stockpile compute, capital and talent. The piece follows Zhipu's recent model iterations, GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-FlashX launches, and price increases.
items.why_zh: 在算力与资金密集投入的竞赛中，拆解头部公司的投入结构有助于判断国产大模型的可持续性。
items.why_en: Dissecting a leading player's spending structure helps gauge the sustainability of China's large-model race.

items.title_zh: 【豆包座舱助手发布，荣威家越 07 将率先搭载】 #豆包座舱助手发布#
items.title_en: Doubao Cockpit Assistant Debuts, to Ship First on Roewe Jiayue 07
items.summary_zh: 【豆包座舱助手发布，荣威家越 07 将率先搭载】 #豆包座舱助手发布# 凤凰网科技
items.summary_en: The Doubao cockpit assistant has been launched, with the Roewe Jiayue 07 set to be the first model to carry it. The tie-up brings ByteDance's Doubao model into the smart-cockpit space, where fast response and semantic understanding matter most.
items.why_zh: 智能座舱是大模型落地的重要高频入口，车企与大模型厂商的合作将重塑车内交互体验。
items.why_en: Smart cockpits are a key high-frequency entry point for large models, and automaker tie-ups will reshape in-car interaction.

items.title_zh: 智谱AI9月18日推出GLM-5.3-FlashX 最高200 tokens/s
items.title_en: Zhipu AI Launches GLM-5.3-FlashX With Up to 200 Tokens/s
items.summary_zh: 智谱AI9月18日推出GLM-5.3-FlashX 最高200 tokens/s 观点网
items.summary_en: Zhipu AI released GLM-5.3-FlashX on September 18, with a top output speed of up to 200 tokens/s. The model emphasizes faster responses and smoother experience, alongside expanded compute capacity and pricing adjustments aimed at boosting its overall competitiveness.
items.why_zh: 高吞吐模型配合价格调整，反映国内大模型竞争正从单一能力比拼转向“智能、价格、速度”的综合较量。
items.why_en: A high-throughput model paired with pricing changes shows China's LLM race shifting from pure capability to a combined battle over intelligence, price and speed.

items.title_zh: 扩算力、提速度、提定价！智谱发布GLM-5.3-FlashX
items.title_en: Zhipu Releases GLM-5.3-FlashX, Expanding Compute, Speed and Pricing
items.summary_zh: 扩算力、提速度、提定价！智谱发布GLM-5.3-FlashX QQ News
items.summary_en: Zhipu launched GLM-5.3-FlashX, highlighting expanded compute, faster inference and pricing adjustments. The move pairs raw model capability with service capacity and commercial pricing, factors that directly affect developer and enterprise model choices.
items.why_zh: 同时动算力、速度与价格，说明厂商开始把服务承载能力和商业定价当作模型竞争力的组成部分。
items.why_en: Changing compute, speed and pricing together shows vendors now treat service capacity and commercial pricing as core parts of model competitiveness.

items.title_zh: 国产 AI 芯片新突破！华为昇腾960芯片，将提前发布
items.title_en: Huawei's Ascend 960 Chip to Launch Earlier in New Domestic AI Chip Breakthrough
items.summary_zh: 国产 AI 芯片新突破！华为昇腾960芯片，将提前发布 电子工程专辑
items.summary_en: Huawei's Ascend 960 AI chip will reportedly launch earlier than planned, described as a new breakthrough for domestic AI silicon. The Ascend line is central to China's AI compute supply, so an earlier release could help ease compute constraints.
items.why_zh: 昇腾系列是国内AI算力的关键供给来源，其发布节奏直接影响国内大模型训练与推理的算力可用性。
items.why_en: The Ascend line is a key source of domestic AI compute, so its release timing directly affects compute availability for Chinese model training and inference.

items.title_zh: 智谱GLM-5.3-FlashX模型上线：进一步形成智能、价格、速度的全面竞争力
items.title_en: Zhipu's GLM-5.3-FlashX Goes Live, Targeting All-Round Competitiveness
items.summary_zh: 智谱GLM-5.3-FlashX模型上线：进一步形成智能、价格、速度的全面竞争力 凤凰网
items.summary_en: Zhipu's GLM-5.3-FlashX is now live, with the company aiming for all-round competitiveness across intelligence, price and speed. The positioning balances capability, cost and latency rather than excelling on a single metric.
items.why_zh: 把智能、价格、速度同时作为卖点，是当前大模型在应用落地阶段最受关注的三项实际指标。
items.why_en: Treating intelligence, price and speed as combined selling points reflects the three metrics that matter most when LLMs move into real applications.

items.title_zh: 智谱GLM-5.3-FlashX模型上线，更快、更流畅
items.title_en: Zhipu's GLM-5.3-FlashX Now Available, Faster and Smoother
items.summary_zh: 智谱GLM-5.3-FlashX模型上线，更快、更流畅 凤凰网科技
items.summary_en: Zhipu's GLM-5.3-FlashX is now online, with the company emphasizing faster and smoother performance. The FlashX branding puts speed front and center, with reported peak output of up to 200 tokens/s.
items.why_zh: 推理速度是决定AI应用交互体验与并发成本的关键因素，也是当前模型迭代的重点方向之一。
items.why_en: Inference speed is key to AI app user experience and concurrency cost, making it a central focus of current model updates.

items.title_zh: 智谱推出GLM-5.3-FlashX
items.title_en: Zhipu Introduces GLM-5.3-FlashX Model
items.summary_zh: 智谱推出GLM-5.3-FlashX 东方财富
items.summary_en: Zhipu introduced GLM-5.3-FlashX, a new addition to its model lineup. Reports highlight faster generation of up to 200 tokens/s, along with accompanying adjustments to compute and pricing.
items.why_zh: 智谱是国内主要大模型厂商之一，其高频迭代反映了国产模型在速度与成本上的竞争加剧。
items.why_en: As a major Chinese LLM maker, Zhipu's rapid iteration reflects intensifying competition over speed and cost among domestic models.

items.title_zh: 豆包座舱助手正式发布：“豆包屏”上车，随聊天内容展现不同表情
items.title_en: Doubao Cabin Assistant Launches With In-Car 'Doubao Screen' and Expressive Faces
items.summary_zh: 豆包座舱助手正式发布：“豆包屏”上车，随聊天内容展现不同表情 凤凰网科技
items.summary_en: The Doubao cabin assistant has officially launched, bringing a 'Doubao screen' into the car that shows different expressions along with the conversation. It combines LLM dialogue with in-cabin displays for richer, more emotive interaction.
items.why_zh: 座舱是大模型进入日常场景的重要入口，表情化交互说明车载AI正从语音助手走向多模态体验。
items.why_en: The cockpit is a major entry point for LLMs into daily life, and expressive interaction shows in-car AI moving from voice assistants toward multimodal experiences.

items.title_zh: 豆包大模型再更新，发力多模态编程，一手实测来了
items.title_en: Doubao Model Updated Again, Focusing on Multimodal Coding
items.summary_zh: 豆包大模型再更新，发力多模态编程，一手实测来了 Sohu
items.summary_en: Doubao's large model has been updated again, this time focused on multimodal coding, with hands-on testing published. Multimodal coding lets models handle images, UI screenshots or documents alongside text prompts in code tasks.
items.why_zh: 多模态编程是AI编程工具的重要演进方向，直接关系到模型在真实开发流程中的可用性。
items.why_en: Multimodal coding is a key evolution path for AI coding tools and directly affects how usable models are in real development workflows.

items.title_zh: 当招聘由智能体代理：双智能体简历筛选中的准入与复现性评估
items.title_en: When Hiring Becomes Agent-Mediated: Evaluating Access and Recurrence in Two-Agent R\'esum\'e Screening
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，招聘本质上是双向的：雇主评估匹配度，候选人则要呈现并辩护自己的资历。然而作为第一道关卡的简历筛选，通常被自动化成对“简历—职位”配对做一次性静态判断。作者提出双智能体替代方案：雇主侧与候选人侧智能体分别扮演双方角色，交换证据并在决定谁进入下一轮前更新各自判断。研究使用 GPT-5.5 与 Claude Opus 4.7，在 600 组构建的简历—职位配对上比较两种流程，发现双智能体筛选会让更多申请者进入后续环节，并进一步考察了准入与复现性问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.19530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hiring is bilateral: employers assess fit, while candidates present and defend evidence of their qualifications. Yet r\'esum\'e screening, the first gate, is commonly automated as a static, one-call judgment over a r\'esum\'e-job pair. We study a two-agent alternative in which employer-side and candidate-side agents represent these roles, exchange evidence, and update their judgments before deciding who advances. We compare procedures on 600 constructed r\'esum\'e-job pairs using GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7. Two-agent screening advances more appl…
items.why_zh: 招聘第一道关卡的自动化方式直接决定谁能获得机会，也牵涉 AI 筛选的公平性与可复现性。
items.why_en: How the first hiring gate is automated shapes who gets access to opportunity and raises fairness and reproducibility concerns for AI screening.

items.title_zh: 求解最小跨度反带宽与循环反带宽标号问题
items.title_en: Solving Minimum Span Antibandwidth and Cyclic Antibandwidth Labeling Problems
items.summary_zh: 反带宽与循环反带宽是 NP 难的图标号问题，目标是最大化相邻顶点所分配标签之间的最小（循环）距离。大量已有研究给出了多种数学建模与计算方法，但它们的“最小跨度”互补视角——即先固定一个规定的最小（循环）距离，再最小化标签跨度——受到的关注相对较少。本文针对这一互补视角展开研究，围绕该问题给出建模与求解思路，以填补这一研究空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.20091v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Antibandwidth and Cyclic Antibandwidth problems are NP-hard graph labeling problems that aim to maximize the minimum (cyclic) distance between labels assigned to adjacent vertices. Extensive research on these problems has resulted in a variety of mathematical formulations and computational approaches. However, their minimum span perspective, in which a prescribed minimum (cyclic) distance is fixed and the objective is to minimize the label span, has received comparatively little attention. In this paper, we consider this complementary perspec…
items.why_zh: 为长期被忽视的 NP 难图标号问题补充了最小跨度视角，拓展了可行的建模与求解方向。
items.why_en: It adds a largely unexplored minimum-span perspective to NP-hard graph labeling problems, opening new modeling and solving directions.

items.title_zh: AI 驱动的智慧城市 NR-V2X 网络实时中继优化：基于学习优化的图神经网络
items.title_en: AI-Driven Real-Time Relay Optimisation in Smart Urban NR-V2X Networks via Learning-to-Optimise Graph Neural Networks
items.summary_zh: 可靠且低时延的通信是智慧城市服务与工业 4.0 应用的基础需求，而 NR-V2X 网络正是重要承载技术。但路侧单元（RSU）部署有限、城市传播条件复杂，常使联网自动驾驶车辆（CAV）难以保持稳定连接。论文提出一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的 AI 驱动“学习优化”（L2O）框架，把车辆网络建模为图，用于 NR-V2X 系统中的实时多跳中继选择，以改善连接稳定性与时延表现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.20271v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reliable and low-latency communication is a fundamental requirement for smart city services and Industry 4.0 applications enabled by NR-V2X networks. However, limited Road-Side Unit (RSU) deployment and complex urban propagation conditions often prevent Connected and Automated Vehicles (CAVs) from maintaining stable connectivity. This paper proposes an AI-driven Learning-to-Optimise (L2O) framework based on Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for real-time multi-hop relay selection in NR-V2X systems. The vehicular network is modelled as a graph, where n…
items.why_zh: 为基础设施受限的城市车联网提供了用 AI 保障低时延可靠连接的新思路。
items.why_en: It offers an AI approach to maintaining reliable, low-latency connectivity in urban vehicular networks with limited infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 视觉语言模型能评判奥运跳水吗？从推理到打分的零样本动作质量评估
items.title_en: Can Vision-Language Models Judge Olympic Diving? From Reasoning to Scores in Zero-Shot Action Quality Assessment
items.summary_zh: 由于人体动作复杂、专家评分本身带有主观性，奥运项目的自动化动作质量评估（AQA）一直是难题。该工作评估开源视觉语言模型（VLM）在 AQA-7 基准数据集上对奥运跳水视频进行零样本动作质量评估的能力。作者提出一个基于回归的框架，利用 VLM 产生的语义推理与分阶段子分数，并结合 TF-IDF 向量化等手段生成最终评估结果，从而检验通用视觉语言模型能否胜任这类专业评分任务。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.19354v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Automated action quality assessment (AQA) in Olympic sports remains a challenging task due to the complexity of human motion and the subjectivity inherent in expert judging. This work evaluates the capability of open-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to perform zero-shot action quality assessment on Olympic diving videos using the AQA-7 benchmark dataset. In this regard, a regression-based framework is pro-posed to leverage both the semantic reasoning and phase-level sub-scores generated by the VLMs, combining TF-IDF vectorization, dimension…
items.why_zh: 检验通用视觉语言模型能否涉足主观性强的专业体育评分，对 AQA 研究具有参考意义。
items.why_en: It tests whether general-purpose vision-language models can handle highly subjective expert scoring tasks in sports.

items.title_zh: 如何引导你的语言流：面向扩散语言模型的探针引导
items.title_en: How to Guide Your Language Flow
items.summary_zh: 论文提出一种引导流匹配模型的新方法，称为“探针引导”（probe guidance）。它利用已有扩散模型冻结的内部状态来构造引导信号，原理与 autoguidance 类似，但省去了推理阶段额外的前向传播，并提供可靠途径来确保弱模型与强模型具有相近的动态。作者将该方法应用于连续扩散语言模型并进行基准测试，探针引导在其中取得了新的最优性能。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.19356v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce a new method to guide flow matching models. Our approach, which we call probe guidance, uses the frozen internal states of an existing diffusion model to construct a guidance signal. This works using a similar principle as autoguidance, but eliminates the need for an additional forward pass at inference time and provides a reliable path to ensure that the weak and strong model share similar dynamics. We apply and benchmark this method on continuous diffusion language models, where probe guidance sets a new state-of-the-art performa…
items.why_zh: 在不增加推理开销的前提下提升扩散语言模型的生成质量，兼顾效果与效率。
items.why_en: It improves generation quality in diffusion language models without extra inference cost, balancing performance and efficiency.

items.title_zh: DeltaSelect：面向编程智能体的低成本 A/B 测试
items.title_en: DeltaSelect: Affordable A/B Testing for Coding Agents
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，编程智能体基准是为广泛、全面的比较而设计的，并不适合频繁的开发决策：单次运行结果波动大、跑完整套件成本高，而且基准测试框架可能与实际使用的框架不一致。作者对 DeepSWE 已公布的试验做重采样分析，发现 113 个任务中仅 22 个（19.5%）与全基准性能的第五百分位 Pearson 相关达到 0.50 以上。为此论文提出开源方法 DeltaSelect，用来找出单次运行结果能稳定反映全基准性能的任务。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.19607v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Coding-agent benchmarks are built for broad and comprehensive comparisons, not frequent development decisions. Individual runs vary, full suites are expensive, and the benchmark harness may differ from the harness used in practice. In a resampling analysis of DeepSWE's published trials, only 19.5% of tasks (22 of 113) had a fifth-percentile Pearson correlation of at least 0.50 with full-benchmark performance. The paper presents DeltaSelect, an open-source method that identifies tasks whose one-run results consistently track full-benchmark perfo…
items.why_zh: 让团队以更低成本、更可靠地评估编程智能体的改动是否真正带来提升。
items.why_en: It lets teams evaluate changes to coding agents more cheaply and reliably.

items.title_zh: AquiLLM：评估面向科学研究的开放权重 RAG-LLM 系统忠实性
items.title_en: AquiLLM: Evaluating Faithfulness in Open-Weight RAG-LLM Systems for Scientific Research
items.summary_zh: 科学研究日益依赖大规模、异构的数据来源，这推动了检索增强生成（RAG）系统的研究兴趣——用自然语言访问科学知识与研究流程。研究者正在探索这类系统作为文档检索的自然语言界面，以及生成分析代码和流水线组件的可行性。与此同时，对数据隐私和研究基础设施控制权的担忧，也促使人们转向开放权重模型与开源部署。AquiLLM 关注的问题正是：这类开放 RAG-LLM 系统在科研场景中的回答是否忠实可靠。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.16519v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Scientific research increasingly relies on large, heterogeneous data sources, motivating interest in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that provide natural language access to scientific knowledge and research workflows. Researchers are exploring the viability of these systems as natural language interfaces for document search and for generating analysis code and pipeline components. At the same time, concerns about data privacy and control over research infrastructure have motivated interest in open-weight models and open-source de…
items.why_zh: 科研场景采用开放权重 RAG 系统前，必须先确认其输出是否忠实可信。
items.why_en: Before adopting open-weight RAG systems in research, their faithfulness must be established.

items.title_zh: BuildBench：在编译真实开源软件上评测 LLM 智能体
items.title_en: BuildBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Compiling Real-World Open-Source Software
items.summary_zh: 自动编译开源软件（OSS）项目是一项重要、劳动密集且复杂的任务，因而很适合作为 LLM 智能体的挑战。现有方法依赖人工整理的规则与工作流，难以适应需要定制配置或环境搭建的开源项目；近期基于 LLM 的尝试往往只在少量高评分 OSS 上做选择性评测，低估了现实中编译任务的难度——真实场景中编译说明常常缺失或不完整。论文提出 BuildBench，在更贴近现实的开源项目上对 LLM 智能体进行评测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2509.25248v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Automatically compiling open-source software (OSS) projects is a vital, labor-intensive, and complex task, which makes it a good challenge for LLM Agents. Existing methods rely on manually curated rules and workflows, which cannot adapt to OSS that requires customized configuration or environment setup. Recent attempts using Large Language Models (LLMs) used selective evaluation on a subset of highly rated OSS, a practice that underestimates the realistic challenges of OSS compilation. In practice, compilation instructions are often abs…
items.why_zh: 提供更贴近现实的软件构建基准，真实衡量 LLM 智能体解决实际工程问题的能力。
items.why_en: It provides a more realistic benchmark for measuring how well LLM agents solve real-world software build problems.

items.title_zh: FedVideoMAE：结合差分隐私与安全聚合的高效联邦视频审核框架
items.title_en: FedVideoMAE: Efficient Federated Video Moderation with Differential Privacy and Secure Aggregation
items.summary_zh: 短视频审核正日益转向边缘端和隐私敏感场景：用户可能只想把视频分享给好友或私密群组，但把原始片段上传到中心服务器会扩大曝光面、消耗带宽并增加审核延迟。联邦学习可以让视频留在本地设备上，然而未受保护的模型更新仍可能泄露信息，而且全视频骨干网络的通信开销很高。为此研究者提出 FedVideoMAE，一个面向暴力内容检测的隐私保护联邦框架，将差分隐私与安全聚合结合起来。该工作希望在不把原始视频送出设备的前提下实现高效审核。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2512.18809v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Short-form video moderation is increasingly pushed toward edge and privacy-sensitive settings, where users may intend videos for a limited audience, such as friends or private groups, but sending raw clips to a central server can broaden exposure, consume bandwidth, and add moderation latency. Federated learning can keep videos on device, but unprotected model updates may still leak information, and full-video backbones are expensive to communicate. We present FedVideoMAE, a privacy-preserving federated framework for violence detection…

items.title_zh: CoMa：用视觉语言模型生成贴合城市脉络的建筑体量
items.title_en: CoMa: Contextual Massing Generation with Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 上下文感知的建筑体量生成是设计早期的重要任务：给定一块建设用地，生成的体量不仅要适配目标地块，还应与周边城市肌理的尺度、密度和形态相协调。这一任务天然是多模态的——输出需要保持结构化和可编辑，而周边环境（其他建筑、道路等）可以用矢量几何、地图影像或三维视图来表示。论文研究了这种上下文体量生成问题，并提出了名为 CoMa 的方法，借助视觉语言模型来完成生成。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.08464v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Context-aware building massing is an important early-stage design task: given a site for buildings, a generated massing should not only fit the target parcel, but also relate to the scale, density, and morphology of its surrounding urban fabric. This task is naturally multimodal, since the target output should remain structured and editable, while the surrounding context, including other buildings or roads, can be represented as vector geometry, map imagery, or three-dimensional views. items.why_zh: 它把多模态视觉语言模型引入建筑设计早期的体量生成，让生成的方案更贴合真实的城市环境。
items.why_en: It brings multimodal vision-language models into early-stage architectural massing, making generated proposals more responsive to real urban context.

items.title_zh: Teach and Grow：面向通用机器人学习的以智能体为中心架构
items.title_en: Teach and Grow: An Agent-Centered Architecture for General Robot Learning
items.summary_zh: 视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型和世界动作模型通常需要额外采集机器人数据并做策略优化，才能掌握陌生的操作任务，这种反复重训练拖慢了新行为的学习速度。作者提出 Teach-and-Grow Learning（TGL），一种免训练架构，能把少量成功示范转化为可复用的机器人技能。任务获取不需要梯度更新、微调或强化学习：在机器人扩展其显式知识的过程中，预训练模型权重保持不变。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.17209v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models typically absorb unfamiliar manipulation tasks through additional robot data collection and policy optimization. This recurring retraining burden slows the acquisition of new behavior. We present Teach-and-Grow Learning (TGL), a training-free architecture that turns a few successful demonstrations into reusable robot skills. items.why_zh: 无需重训练即可获得新技能，有望大幅降低机器人学习新任务所需的时间与数据成本。
items.why_en: Acquiring new skills without retraining could sharply cut the time and data cost of teaching robots new tasks.

items.title_zh: Odds-Ratio Thompson Sampling：面向对比式多臂老虎机的规范与设计指南
items.title_en: Odds-Ratio Thompson Sampling: A Specification and Design Guide for Contrast-Based Multi-Armed Bandits
items.summary_zh: 批量式多臂老虎机按服务自身的节奏更新，常见实现会把每个臂的绝对奖励率从一次更新带到下一次。当共享的基准水平在批次之间发生移动时，这种记忆就会过时，即便臂之间的相对比较并未改变。论文提出的 Odds-Ratio Thompson Sampling（OR-TS）改为携带对数几率对比（log-odds contrasts）的联合后验，并在每个批次重新拟合共享水平、将其边缘化消除。文章给出了该更新方式的规范，并将其置于一个带有两项控制参数的贝叶斯老虎机智能体之中。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.19709v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Batched multi-armed bandits update on a service's own schedule, and the usual implementation carries each arm's absolute reward rate from one update to the next. When the shared level moves between batches, that memory goes stale even though the comparisons between arms may not have. Odds-Ratio Thompson Sampling (OR-TS) instead carries the joint posterior over log-odds contrasts and fits the common level afresh in every batch, marginalizing it out. This paper specifies that update, places it inside a Bayesian bandit agent with two controls, decay…
items.why_zh: 它指出并修正了批量老虎机中一个容易被忽视的失效模式，为对比式更新的设计与调参提供了规范参考。
items.why_en: It identifies and corrects an easily overlooked failure mode in batched bandits, giving practitioners a specification and design guide for contrast-based updates.
